jobs.occupation: Technical Lead – IoT to Alfa Laval!
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced software engineer looking to lead through technical expertise, mentorship, and collaboration – while continuing to develop hands-on software? For Alfa Laval's IoT Development Team, we are now looking for a Technical Lead to drive the development of scalable IoT solutions for Alfa Laval's global product portfolio!
About the role
In this role, you will be part of a collaborative IoT development team, serving as the technical anchor and guide for engineers while turning business requirements into scalable cloud solutions.
Alfa Laval contributes to a more sustainable future through technical innovation. The company's solutions help customers improve efficiency across industries such as marine, energy, water treatment, food production, and pharmaceuticals.
Alfa Laval's IoT solutions enable remote support, data visualization, and performance analytics for industrial machinery. By analyzing data in real time, the systems help global customers optimize operations and regulatory compliance, reduce unplanned downtime, and lower their environmental footprint. Alfa Laval offers a collaborative and inclusive environment where employees are encouraged to take initiative, share ideas, and turn innovations into reality.
You are Offered
Global Impact within IoT: The opportunity to build advanced IoT solutions that connect industrial machinery and are used worldwide.
International Collaboration: Extensive collaboration with international teams and global stakeholders in an open, non-hierarchical environment.
Long-Term Development: Strong opportunities for technical growth, broader architecture responsibilities, and flexible career paths within a world-leading industrial group.
Flexibility & Balance: A collaborative work environment with a hybrid setup (based in either Flemingsberg or Lund) and a healthy work-life balance.

Work tasks
As Technical Lead in one of the IoT Development Teams, you will work closely with developers, Product Owners, Delivery Leads, business stakeholders, and DevOps teams to translate business needs into robust, dependable technical solutions. The role entails end-to-end responsibility for technical design, implementation, and estimation, while remaining actively engaged in hands-on software development and coaching the team forward. Your primary responsibilities:
Lead technical design, solution definition, and estimation activities, translating business requirements into scalable and maintainable solutions.  
Mentor engineers through technical guidance, code reviews, testing practices, and the promotion of engineering best practices.  
Collaborate across teams and stakeholders to align solutions, manage dependencies, and ensure efficient delivery.  
Support the full software development lifecycle, including implementation, deployment, maintenance, and operational handover.  
Remain actively involved in hands-on software development and technical problem solving, contributing where your expertise provides the greatest value.  
Ensure solutions meet requirements for performance, usability, maintainability, stability, and cybersecurity.

We are looking for someone who 
Has extensive software development experience with a strong focus on C# and .NET / .NET Core.
Has experience designing scalable backend systems and APIs for distributed environments.
Has practical experience with cloud development, primarily in Microsoft Azure (experience with AWS or GCP is also valued), as well as containerization with Docker.
Has experience in technical mentorship – you enjoy guiding other developers, conducting code reviews, and establishing engineering best practices within an agile team.
Is fully proficient in English, both spoken and written (corporate and team language).

It is meritorious if you have
Experience in IoT and Telemetry: Hands-on work with connected devices, industrial monitoring, edge computing, or time-series databases (e.g., TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
Broader Architectural Expertise: Familiarity with microservices, distributed system design, or event-driven architecture.
DevOps & Tooling: Experience with DevOps practices, automated deployments, Azure DevOps, Linux-based environments, or scripting languages (e.g., Python).
Frontend Understanding: Basic familiarity with modern frontend frameworks such as Angular.

To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:
Supportive
Goal oriented
Orderly
Stable
Responsible
Assertive

Other information
A background check is part of the final stage of the recruitment process.

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.
Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

jobs.occupation: Sales Coordinator to an International Company in the MedTech Industry!
jobs.description:
Are you a Finnish-speaking professional who enjoys taking ownership, coordinating complex processes, and working with multiple stakeholders? Do you have experience in order management, sales support, or B2B administration? Are you someone who likes to take responsibility and ensure that everything runs smoothly from start to finish? Then this could be the perfect opportunity for you!
We are currently looking for a Sales Coordinator to join a well-established international company within the medical technology industry. In this role, you will play an important part in ensuring that customer orders are managed efficiently, accurately, and delivered according to plan.
You will primarily support the Finnish market and become part of a collaborative Nordic sales organization based in Stockholm.
About the Role:
As a Sales Coordinator, you will have end-to-end responsibility for customer orders, from the initial order placement through to delivery and final invoicing.
This is much more than an order administration position. You will be responsible for keeping the entire process together, identifying potential issues, coordinating different departments, and ensuring that every order is handled correctly and within the agreed timeframe.
You will act as a central point of contact between customers, the sales organization, service teams, project managers, international factories, and the finance department.
Your Main Responsibilities:
Receive, review, and register customer orders, primarily via email.
Ensure that order documentation, pricing, and delivery terms are accurate and complete.
Communicate with customers and sales representatives to clarify or obtain missing order information.
Coordinate complex orders involving multiple factories, deliveries, and internal functions.
Monitor order progress and ensure that products are delivered according to schedule.
Collaborate with service coordinators and project managers to prepare for product installations.
Ensure a smooth and accurate handover to the service organization.
Follow up on open orders and ensure that invoicing takes place at the correct time.
Manage partial deliveries and invoicing in multiple stages.
Communicate deviations and changes in invoicing schedules to the finance department.
Take ownership of your orders and ensure that each process is followed through to completion.

About You:
We are looking for someone with previous experience in order coordination, order management, sales support, or qualified B2B customer service.
You have a good understanding of how different parts of an order process are connected, from receiving an order to coordinating deliveries and ensuring that invoicing is completed correctly.
You are comfortable taking ownership of your work, coordinating multiple stakeholders, and handling both routine tasks and more complex situations. You understand the importance of keeping track of details while maintaining an overview of the entire process.
To Succeed in This Role, We Believe You Have:
Approximately two years of experience in a similar position.
Previous experience in order coordination, order management, sales support, or qualified B2B customer service.
Experience independently managing and following up on order processes, preferably from order placement through to delivery and invoicing.
An understanding of how orders, deliveries, installations, and invoicing are connected.
Experience coordinating several internal and external stakeholders.
The ability to manage complex cases and keep multiple processes moving simultaneously.
Previous experience working with ERP or other business management systems.
Good general computer skills and the ability to quickly learn new systems and processes.
Excellent communication skills in Finnish and English, both written and spoken.

Experience working with SAP or Salesforce is also considered a plus.
Who Are You as a Person?
You are a responsible, structured, and proactive individual who enjoys taking ownership and driving processes forward.
You are detail-oriented and understand the importance of accuracy when handling customer orders, deliveries, and invoicing. At the same time, you are able to maintain an overview and ensure that all the different parts of the process come together.
You are confident in making decisions and taking action when something needs to be resolved. Rather than waiting for someone else to follow up, you take initiative and make sure things get done.
You also have strong communication skills and enjoy working with different stakeholders, both internally and externally. You understand the importance of keeping everyone informed and ensuring smooth collaboration between departments.
Interested?
Does this sound like the right opportunity for you? We would love to hear from you!
Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

jobs.occupation: Head of Production
jobs.description:
Did you know that Sweden's largest shipyard for ship repair and conversion projects is in Landskrona? At Oresund DryDocks, vessels from across Northern Europe and beyond come to us for complex repair, maintenance and conversion projects. With a strong reputation for quality, safety and delivery performance, we are a leading player in the maritime industry.
Our success is built on the expertise and commitment of approximately 110 employees, working across project management, engineering, production and support functions. 
We are now looking for a Head of Production to lead and further develop our production organization.
The Role as Head of Production
As Head of Production, you will have overall responsibility for leading, developing and optimizing the production organization through your department managers within Steel, Piping, Mechanical, and Dock & Transport.
You will ensure that the organization has the right resources, competencies, processes and working methods in place to successfully deliver projects according to established targets for safety, quality, cost efficiency and delivery performance.
As a member of the management team, you will play a key role in driving operational excellence and contributing to the company's long-term strategic development. The position requires a visible and engaged leadership style, with a strong presence in the business and close collaboration with employees, customers and stakeholders.
Experience
You have several years of experience in a senior production leadership role within the maritime, shipyard, manufacturing or other project-driven industrial sectors.
You have a proven track record of:

Leading managers and larger production organizations through delegated responsibility

Driving operational performance and achieving demanding business objectives

Developing organizations, processes and working methods to improve efficiency, productivity and delivery precision

Building and strengthening a proactive safety culture with a strong focus on HSEQ

Managing operations in an international business environment

Experience from project-driven production environments where flexibility, coordination and customer focus are critical is highly valued.
Leadership Profile
You are a confident and inspiring leader who leads by example. Through clear communication and a structured approach, you create engagement, accountability and commitment throughout the organization.
You are results-oriented and combine a strong business mindset with a genuine interest in people development. You can balance strategic thinking with operational execution and are comfortable making decisions in a dynamic environment.
To succeed in the role, you should have:

Strong leadership and people management skills

Excellent planning and organizational abilities

A strong focus on quality, safety and customer satisfaction

Good technical understanding and the ability to translate business objectives into operational activities

Excellent communication skills in both Swedish and English, written and spoken

Meritorious Qualifications

Experience from the shipbuilding, ship repair or maritime industry

Experience in Lean Manufacturing and Continuous Improvement

What We Offer
At Oresund DryDocks, you will become part of a highly skilled and dedicated team operating within an exciting international industry.
We offer a challenging and varied leadership role with significant opportunities to influence both operational performance and the future development of the company. Our organization is characterized by short decision-making paths, a collaborative culture and a strong commitment to continuous improvement.
You will work alongside talented colleagues from diverse backgrounds who share a passion for delivering high-quality solutions to our customers. We believe that every employee contributes to our success and we actively support both personal and professional development.
As our business continues to grow, new opportunities and challenges arise every day. We therefore seek a leader who enjoys being present in the operation, building trust with employees, customers and subcontractors, and creating the conditions for long-term success.
To learn more about us, please visit www.oddab.eu
Application
We welcome your application through CV upload or LinkedIn profile.
Selection and interviews will be conducted continuously. We therefore encourage interested candidates to apply as soon as possible.
Background checks and pre-employment medical examinations form part of our recruitment process.
For further information, please contact:
Jonas Bessing
Head of Recruitment
+46 (0)736-264750 or at jbe@oddab.eu.
Join Oresund DryDocks and become a key contributor to the continued success and development of Sweden's leading shipyard for repair and conversion projects.

jobs.occupation: Environment Expert
jobs.description:
At Tetra Pak we commit to making food safe and available, everywhere; and we protect what's good – protecting food, protecting people, and protecting the planet. By doing so we touch millions of people's lives every day. 
And we need people like you to make it happen.
We empower you to reach your potential with opportunities to make an impact to be proud of – for food, people and the planet.
Job Summary
We are looking for an environmental expert to be a part of AB Tetra Paks Site Management team, reporting to AB Tetra Paks Environment manager.
AB Tetra Pak Site Management safeguards the licence to operate and creates the conditions for continued development of Tetra Pak’s Swedish businesses across all sites to operate safely, sustainably, efficiently and resiliently by providing local governance, compliance, infrastructure and cross-company coordination, as well as managing and coordinating relationships with relevant external authorities within these areas. 
You will be a part of a team dedicated to in realising the strategic ambitions of the Swedish sites within our Sustainability topics Climate, Circularity and Nature. Your role will have a focus on data management, digitalization, analyses och communication.
You will be based in Lund, Sweden but you will work in a global arena.

What you will do
As our new Environment Expert you will:
Drive projects and implement central initiatives in our Swedish business based on a data driven approach, to secure compliance to legal and internal requirements and to improve the Swedish sites environmental performance.
Collaborate with stakeholders, such as other environmental experts, our business and authorities.
Be one of the driving parts in developing of our Swedish Sustainability report. Contributing with texts and insights.
Coordinate our Swedish local sustainability data process related to areas such as climate, energy, water and waste, from collection and validation to analysis and internal and external reporting.
Develop smarter and more efficient ways of managing, structuring, automating and using Swedish sustainability data in our value chain. Proactively identify and drive continuous improvements in data management.
Transform complex data across systems and our value chain into clear insights, visualisations and compelling sustainability communication, as a support for decision-making in project and improvement initiatives.

We believe you have
You have a master’s degree in engineering with a relevant environmental specialisation, or an equivalent qualification.
You have professional experience in the environmental field.
You are fluent in Swedish and English, written and spoken.
You have proven communications skills, written and spoken as well as a strategic mindset.
Have strong working knowledge of data analysis and programming tools, such as Power BI, Excel, Python etc.
Have strong working knowledge of visualisation and presenting, such as PowerPoint and Adobe InDesign.
Previous experiences of working within the Tetra Pak organisation are considered meritorious

We Offer You
A variety of exciting challenges with ample opportunities for development and training in a truly global landscape
A culture that pioneers a spirit of innovation where our industry experts drive visible results
An equal opportunity employment experience that values diversity and inclusion
Market competitive compensation and benefits with flexible working arrangements

 
Apply Now
If you are inspired to be part of our promise to protect what’s good; for food, people, and the planet, apply through our careers page at https://jobs.tetrapak.com/. 
This job posting expires on 2026-11-17
To know more about the position contact Ola Trulsson at +46 46 36 2029
Questions about your application contact Josephine Malalla at +46 46 36 5253
For trade union information contact Akademikerklubben Lars Haraldsson at +46 46 36 2533 and Unionen Lisbeth Larsson at +46 46 36 2320
Diversity, equity, and inclusion is an everyday part of how we work. We give people a place to belong and support to thrive, an environment where everyone can be comfortable being themselves and has equal opportunities to grow and succeed. We embrace difference, celebrate people for who they are, and for the diversity they bring that helps us better understand and connect with our customers and communities worldwide.

jobs.occupation: CEO for a pioneering technology company
jobs.description:
Do you thrive on creating business value, leading people and bringing pioneering technology to market? Would you like to spearhead a company developing innovative solutions for growing international markets?
Our client is looking for a CEO to lead its next phase, working closely with the engineers and scientists behind the company's technology. You will develop the business, bring the organisation together around clear priorities and build the international relationships that turn technical progress into commercial opportunities.
This is an opportunity to lead the commercialization of proprietary technology, combining the expertise of a highly qualified technical team with your own ability to build an international business.
Does this sound like the opportunity for you? Read on.

About the role
As CEO, you will lead and develop the company across its two business areas. You will shape the business strategy with the board and take responsibility for its execution within the agreed budget, translating it into priorities and shared goals.
You will act on and create business opportunities and personally drive key commercial relationships and negotiations. Working closely with the technical leadership, CFO/COO and board, you will unite customer needs, technical capabilities and financial priorities.
The role calls for commercial judgement and enough technical understanding to work confidently with customers, partners and specialists. You will draw on the expertise within the organisation while taking responsibility for decisions, direction and progress.
The company is based in Gothenburg, Sweden. The role requires regular on-site presence with the team and international travel.

In this role you will

Develop and execute the commercial direction in alignment with the board, focusing on markets and opportunities with the strongest commercial potential.

Use and develop your international network to build relationships with industrial customers and partners.

Personally drive complex business opportunities from initial dialogue through negotiation to agreement.

Build internal structures, with clear responsibilities, decision-making and follow-up.

Lead the organisation towards shared goals, aligning technical development and resources with business priorities.

Prioritize resources towards the most attractive opportunities within the agreed budget, taking responsibility for cash flow and funding planning together with the CFO/COO and board.

Communicate progress, opportunities and risks clearly to employees, the board and investors.

Build relationships with investors and lead capital raising initiatives.

To succeed in this role you will bring

Experience leading and developing a technology-intensive business, business unit or commercial function, with responsibility for people, resources and financial results.

The ability to turn strategic goals into clear priorities, effective ways of working and measurable progress.

A hands-on approach with the ability to deliver results in a small organization with limited resources.

A proven record of personally developing and closing complex international B2B technology agreements with industrial customers.

A relevant international industry network and experience bringing new technology to market, including customer testing, qualification or development partnerships.

Solid technical understanding and commercial experience from technology-driven markets such as advanced electronics, materials, energy technology, industrial technology or related fields.

A relevant educational background in technology or business, or equivalent professional experience, excellent English and the ability to travel internationally.

Additional experience we value
Previous CEO responsibility, capital raising and experience in a listed company is valuable. Experience in industrial automation, telecommunications, sensor technology or advanced manufacturing may also be relevant where it includes comparable commercialisation and industrial business development.

Personal qualities
You are a clear and approachable leader who takes responsibility for the whole business. You listen to the expertise around you, make considered decisions and explain the priorities behind them. You enjoy creating opportunities and stay involved in the work needed to move them forward. When conditions change or the way ahead is uncertain, you maintain focus, adapt your approach and keep people informed. You build trust through realistic expectations and consistent follow-through.

Application and contact
Do you recognize yourself in this description? We would love to hear from you!
Please send us your application, we look forward to meeting you.
We review applications on an ongoing basis, so do not wait to apply.

If you have questions about the role, please contact
Linus Pihlsgård, linus.pihlsgard@getskills.se
Or
Mimmi Nyman, mimmi.nyman@getskills.se

jobs.occupation: Support & Digital Workplace Manager to the Stockholm School of Economics
jobs.description:
We offer you 
ITS at the Stockholm School of Economics (SSE), technology is a critical enabler for world-class education, research and administration. As digitalization, automation and AI continue to transform the way people work, we are investing in the next generation of support services and digital workplace experiences. 
We are now looking for a Support & Digital Workplace Manager to lead and develop our Support team within IT Services. The support team is split into 4 functions with separate responsibilities, AV and lecture hall, ServiceDesk, ExEd support, and Student IT Support. 
This is a unique opportunity to combine people leadership, service management and digital transformation in an international and knowledge-driven environment. You will have a central role in shaping how support services evolve and how SSE leverages automation, self-service and AI to improve the user experience and increase organizational productivity. 
As part of the newly established leadership structure within IT Services, you will have significant influence over the future development of support services and the digital workplace at SSE 
About the Role 
This is an opportunity for a leader who is equally comfortable managing daily operations while driving longer-term transformation initiatives. 
You will lead SSE's Support team and be responsible for ensuring a high-quality user experience for students, faculty and staff. At the same time, you will drive the development of support services, processes, self-service capabilities, and AI-enabled ways of working. 
The role is expected to remain actively involved in operational support delivery and end-user services while providing leadership and direction for the wider support function. 
The support function plays a vital role within IT Services, supporting users across a broad range of technologies, platforms and workplace services including Microsoft 365, identity and access management, endpoint management, collaboration tools and end-user support.  
Responsibilities 
Participate actively in Service Desk operations and end-user support. 
Lead, coach and develop the Support team, including performance reviews, staffing and responsibility for the work environment. 
Plan and prioritize daily operations, balancing workloads and ensuring timely resolution of support requests. 
Monitor service quality, user feedback and performance metrics, and turn findings into improvements. 
Improve service levels and the overall user experience by developing support processes, documentation and knowledge sharing, using user feedback and service metrics to drive continuous improvement. 
Develop self-service and automation and support the effective use of AI-enabled tools where they add value. 
Work with students, faculty and staff to understand their needs and identify improvements to digital workplace services. 
Coordinate with colleagues across infrastructure, development and security to resolve issues and improve services. 

Your profile 
We are looking for an engaged and forward-thinking leader with a strong user focus and a passion for continuous improvement. 
You understand what excellent support looks like and have the ability to develop both services and people in that direction. You enjoy creating structure, building high-performing teams, and driving change in a collaborative environment. 
You are curious about emerging technologies and see AI, automation, and modern workplace solutions as opportunities to enhance both employee experience and operational effectiveness. 
You are a strong communicator who can build trust across technical and non-technical stakeholder groups and translate business needs into practical solutions. 
Requirements 
Experience leading, coordinating or developing IT support, service desk or end-user services. 
Experience working with IT Service Management principles and processes. 
Experience driving operational improvements and service development initiatives. 
Experience managing stakeholders and working closely with business users. 
Strong understanding of Microsoft 365 and modern workplace technologies. 
Experience using data and service metrics to improve performance. 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English 
Written and verbal communication skills in Swedish 

Meritorious 
Experience leading support or workplace transformation initiatives. 
Experience as a manager with formal responsibility for employees, preferably within IT support, service desk or end-user services. 
Experience implementing or supporting Microsoft Copilot, Power Platform or other AI-enabled workplace tools. 
Experience with automation, self-service platforms or service optimization. 
Experience from higher education or other knowledge-intensive organizations. 
ITIL certification or equivalent service management training. 
Experience leading change management initiatives 

Other 
This is a full-time, permanent position with an initial six-month probationary period. The position is based in central Stockholm. Start date is as soon as possible. 
The position may become subject to security clearance requirements. If applicable, employment will be conditional upon successful completion of the required screening process. 
We encourage you to apply promptly as we are actively reviewing applications on an ongoing basis.

jobs.occupation: Senior Sales Manager BESS Germany & Central Europe
jobs.description:
Company description:
.
Job description:    Volvo Energy is one of the Volvo Group’s newest business areas, created to accelerate electrification and develop profitable, sustainable energy solutions. We are now expanding our Battery Energy Storage Systems business in Germany and Central Europe.
 This is a unique opportunity to join a growing energy business combining the agility of a new venture with Volvo Group’s capabilities, customer relationships and long-term commitment. Together, we will shape solutions for a more resilient and sustainable energy system.
 What you will do 
As Senior Sales Manager BESS – Germany & Central Europe, you will drive our growth by developing the German market, converting complex opportunities and building long-term customer and partner relationships. Reporting to the Head of Sales EU & International, you will work closely with Volvo Energy’s commercial and technical teams to:
 •    Build and convert the BESS pipeline in Germany, with responsibility for selected Central European markets.•    Execute account and market plans, delivering sales volume, profitability and pipeline-quality targets.•    Commercialize BESS solutions and services for Commercial & Industrial, EV charging and selected utility-scale applications.•    Take direct responsibility for originating, developing and closing complex BESS sales, from initial customer engagement through tendering, negotiation, contracting and delivery handover.•    Coordinate internal specialists and external partners to create competitive customer solutions.•    Shape customer offerings, business models, pricing, financing options, partnerships and commercial agreements.•    Build senior relationships with customers, developers, utilities and channel partners across the region.
  Your future team
 Join a close-knit, international team building a new business within Volvo Group. We combine the pace, ownership and entrepreneurial mindset of a start-up with the reach, expertise and stability of a global organization.
 You will work across sales, sales engineering, product, operations, finance and legal in a culture of collaboration, trust, accountability and initiative.
 Who are you? 
You are a commercially driven BESS professional who builds markets and trusted customer relationships, taking ownership from first contact to signed contract. You bring:
  •    A proven track record of originating, developing and closing BESS sales or project opportunities in Commercial & Industrial, EV charging or utility-scale applications.•    Strong commercial understanding of BESS, supported by technical knowledge of grid connection, electrical infrastructure, system design, project development and contracting.•    Experience with German or DACH energy-market customers and procurement processes, including RFIs, RFQs, RFPs, tenders, negotiations and contract award.•    Understanding of BESS business models and value streams, including ancillary services, energy arbitrage, peak shaving, flexibility and revenue stacking.•    Professional fluency in German and English, with the ability to lead commercial and technical discussions in both languages.•    A relevant university degree—or equivalent professional experience—in energy, engineering, business or commercial management.•    Strong commercial judgement, drive and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to manage several opportunities and travel regularly within Germany and Central Europe.
 What’s in it for you? 
Help shape sustainable energy solutions while developing your career in an international environment. We offer:
 •    An attractive package with fixed salary and performance-related variable compensation.•    A company car under the applicable company car policy.•    Mobile working in line with company policy and business requirements.•    Autonomy to shape our BESS business in Germany and Central Europe.•    International collaboration and development opportunities across Volvo Group.
 Location and working model: Based at Volvo Group Trucks Central Europe GmbH in Ismaning, near Munich, with mobile working in line with company policy and business requirements.
 Ready for the next move? 
Ready to help shape Volvo Energy’s BESS business in Germany and Central Europe? We would be pleased to hear from you.We value diverse perspectives and encourage you to apply if you are motivated by creating customer value and contributing to the energy transition—even if your experience does not cover every area listed.
  
 Feel free to contact me if you have further questions  
 Hiring Manager: Belén Neira, Head of Sales EU & International
 Preferred start date: January 2027Application deadline: 16 November 2026   We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.   As part of the recruitment process, a background check as well as alcohol and drug testing may be conducted. You will be informed if applicable. 
We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.

jobs.occupation: F15 Graduate Programme 2027
jobs.description:
Are you eager to influence the future direction of Arla Foods? Do you envision yourself as a future leader?
How will you make an impact?
The Arla F15 Graduate Programme is a two-year, international development programme designed for graduates who want to learn quickly, explore different areas of a global business and grow into future leadership opportunities.
Through three eight-month rotations, you will work on meaningful business projects, build an international network and develop the confidence, skills and experience to make an impact at Arla. Business areas for projects may include Marketing, Sales, HR, Strategy, Sustainability, Business Development, and Supply Chain. We will match you with a suitable department based on business needs and your profile, offering you the chance to learn and make a difference. Your F15 Graduate journey begins on 1st September 2027.

First rotation (8 months - Aarhus, Denmark) Based at one of our offices in Aarhus you will be assigned a strategically important project somewhere in the business.
Second rotation (8 months - Outside Denmark) You will have more influence over your second project assignment, which will give you the opportunity to continue growing in a meaningful way whilst adding real value to Arla.
Third rotation (8 months - Any Arla market) You will collaborate with the business to source potential high impact projects for your third rotation. You will have the most influence over projects during your final rotation.

 
What will make you a successful F15 Graduate?
To apply for the F15 Graduate Programme, please ensure that you meet the following criteria
You should either be in the process of completing, or have completed, a bachelor’s or master’s degree between September 2025 and September 2027. We welcome diverse educational backgrounds but seek candidates with a strong drive towards a business-focused career.
International experience gained from working, studying or volunteering abroad is an advantage.
Preferably at least one year of relevant work experience from student jobs or a minimum of six months of internship experience.
You are globally mobile and willing to go on one or two rotations abroad during the two-year programme. As your first rotation is based in Aarhus, Denmark you will need to relocate unless you already reside in the local area. Arla Foods will support you with this relocation.

 
This programme will suit graduates who have leadership aspirations and an ambitious mindset, which combines strategic thinking with a passion for results. A global mindset is essential, as is the ability to build positive relationships and strong influencing skills. The ideal candidate should be curious, competitive, and open to change, demonstrating resilience, while also being humble, self-aware, and open to feedback.
Throughout the rotations you will receive a variety of development opportunities every step of the way. To ensure your professional and personal development, you will benefit from
Responsibilities from day one, enabling on-the-job learning in three different areas
Graduate development camps, taking place in different markets with your graduate colleagues
One-to-one mentoring and sparring from senior leaders
Be part of a supportive graduate community across all Arla Futures programmes 

Important information before applying
The application period for the F15 Graduate Programme runs from 2nd November 2026 until 2359 CET on 3rd January 2027. Before applying, please ensure you have prepared your CV and cover letter in English. You will be asked a series of questions on the application page, so we recommend that you start the application process from a computer instead of a mobile phone.
For additional information, read more about the F15 Graduate Programme on our website. Here, you can get inspiration from some of our previous and current F15s and learn more about the programme. You can also read more about what to expect from the recruitment process on our website.
Shape the Future of Dairy
Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

jobs.occupation: Senior Power BI & Microsoft Fabric Consultant
jobs.description:
Exciting Opportunity at Tekkli: Senior Power BI & Microsoft Fabric Consultant
Join Tekkli, where innovation meets expertise!
We are looking for an experienced Senior Power BI & Microsoft Fabric Consultant to join our growing team in Helsingborg. If you are passionate about turning complex data into meaningful business insights, building scalable analytical solutions, and working with modern data technologies, we would love to hear from you.
At Tekkli, we combine business understanding, technical expertise, and innovation to create solutions that make a real difference. We value curiosity, continuous learning, and people who challenge conventional ways of working.
Your Role
As a Senior Power BI & Microsoft Fabric Consultant, you will play a key role in developing and strengthening modern Business Intelligence and analytics solutions.
You will work at the intersection of business and technology, transforming business requirements into scalable data models, insightful dashboards, and reliable analytical solutions.
Your responsibilities will include:
Designing, developing, and maintaining advanced Power BI reports, dashboards, and semantic models.
Building reusable and governed analytical solutions that enable self-service reporting.
Developing and optimizing complex DAX measures and calculations.
Designing dimensional data models, including star schemas, fact tables, and dimensions.
Building data transformations and processing solutions using SQL, Python, and PySpark.
Working with Microsoft Fabric capabilities such as Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Pipelines, Dataflows Gen2, and Notebooks.
Optimizing performance, data quality, and reliability across analytical solutions.
Translating business requirements into meaningful KPIs and actionable insights.
Collaborating closely with business stakeholders, data engineers, and other technical teams.
Contributing to modern data architecture, governance, documentation, and best practices.

jobs.occupation: Senior Legal Counsel IP

By offering trucks, buses, construction equipment, power solutions for marine and industrial applications, financing and services that increase our customers’ uptime and productivity.

 Who are we, your new colleagues?  
 Volvo Group IP handles intellectual property matters for the complete Volvo Group – which includes not only Volvo Trucks but also e.g. Volvo Buses, Volvo Penta, Volvo Construction Equipment and autonomous solutions – in a business-integrated, strategic setup with a proactive approach. Volvo Group IP is part of the Truck Technology & Industrial (TTI) division’s Legal & Volvo Group IP function, where we work close to technology and business to enable innovation and protect value.
 Volvo Group IP takes care of the complete life cycle of trademarks, designs and patents, supporting and advising in strategic partnerships, licensing and other complex IP related agreements, driving enforcement and defense matters and handling IP risk assessments.

 As Senior Legal Counsel – Intellectual Property (IP), you will play a key role in protecting and leveraging Volvo Group’s intellectual property while enabling innovation and supporting business priorities across the organization. You will work closely with stakeholders across Volvo’s global operations, providing strategic legal advice and practical solutions in complex IP matters. 
 Combining legal expertise with a strong business perspective, you will help navigate challenging situations, strengthen partnerships and develop the processes and ways of working needed to manage IP effectively in a changing technology landscape. 
 Your responsibilities will include: 
   
Innovation and technology: Support R&D and engineering teams on IP matters related to new technologies, product development and emerging areas such as electrification, software and connectivity. 
 
    
IP risk management: Assess and manages IP risks, including patent infringement, freedom-to-operate questions and potential disputes, working with internal experts and external legal partners as needed. 
 
    
Commercial agreements: Provide IP expertise in negotiations and contract drafting involving technology collaborations, licensing, joint development, complex supplier relations and other strategic partnerships where IP is at the core of the matter. 
 
    
Litigation and enforcement: Manage and support IP disputes, litigation and enforcement matters, working with internal stakeholders and external legal counsel to protect Volvo Group’s rights and interests across the globe. 
 
    
IP awareness and collaboration: Build strong relationships across the organization, helping colleagues understand IP implications and incorporate IP considerations into their everyday work. 
 
    
Continuous improvements: Identify opportunities to strengthen Volvo Group's IP processes, ways of working and ability to capture value from innovation. 
 
  
You will also act as an ambassador for IP both within Volvo Group, and to the wider community and you will protect the Volvo Group brand by supporting our global IP enforcement strategy, taking decisive action against counterfeits, and safeguarding customers, products, and our reputation.  Who are you? Are we a perfect match? 
 You bring hands-on IP expertise. You are a true collaborator—low prestige, high trust—who gets things done and helps your team when needed. You thrive in a fast-moving environment, embrace change and new challenges, and you spot what needs to happen next. You combine a can-do mindset with sound judgement, and you are proactive and autonomous, with a strong sense of ownership.

7+ years’ experience in IP (in-house and/or private practice), covering a broad mix of advisory, transactional and contentious matters. 
 
    
Established expertise across key IP areas (patents, trademarks and designs), including enforcement/defense, licensing/strategic agreements and IP risk management.

Strong business acumen.   
 
    
Strong digital proficiency and a willingness to embrace new and more efficient ways of working.  
 
    
Experience from automotive/industrial technology is a plus. 
 
    
Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken. 
 
    
Strong stakeholder management skills and ability to partner with engineering and senior leaders across a global organization.

jobs.occupation: Lead Mechanical / Piping Commissioning Engineer
jobs.description:
The Lead Mechanical / Piping Commissioning Engineer will report to the Commissioning & Start-Up (CSU) Manager and lead the commissioning, start-up and performance testing of mechanical equipment and piping systems.
The role requires extensive knowledge of static and rotating equipment, piping systems, nitrogen-helium leak testing, flange management, piping testing and associated commissioning activities. Strong technical, organisational and leadership skills are essential to manage mechanical completion, pre-commissioning, commissioning, start-up and handover in accordance with project requirements, industry standards and HSSE expectations.
Key Responsibilities
Commissioning & Start-Up
Lead commissioning and start-up activities for mechanical equipment and piping systems, coordinating with multidisciplinary project teams.
Develop and execute commissioning plans, schedules, procedures and test requirements covering mechanical completion, pre-commissioning, commissioning and start-up.
Coordinate system readiness and commissioning priorities in line with project schedules and operational requirements.
Support plant start-up, performance testing and transition to stable operations.

Mechanical & Piping Technical Leadership
Provide technical leadership for static and rotating equipment and associated piping systems.
Oversee nitrogen-helium leak testing, flange management, piping integrity testing and other pre-commissioning activities.
Ensure mechanical and piping systems comply with approved engineering specifications, relevant standards and project requirements.
Review system configuration, piping arrangements, test requirements and commissioning documentation.
Provide technical guidance to commissioning engineers, contractors and vendor representatives.

Testing & Inspection
Oversee testing and inspection of mechanical equipment and piping systems to verify integrity, functionality and readiness.
Ensure piping test packages, leak testing and mechanical inspection activities are completed and documented.
Verify completion of required inspections and tests prior to system energisation, introduction of process media or start-up.
Monitor deficiencies and ensure outstanding items are addressed before handover.

Troubleshooting & Issue Resolution
Identify and resolve mechanical and piping issues encountered during pre-commissioning and commissioning.
Work with engineering, construction, vendors and operations teams to investigate faults and implement appropriate solutions.
Identify technical constraints affecting system readiness and escalate critical issues where required.

Documentation & Handover
Maintain accurate commissioning records, including test results, checklists, punch lists and relevant as-built documentation.
Ensure commissioning documentation and completion evidence are accurate, traceable and ready for handover.
Manage punch-list close-out and support system walkdowns and acceptance activities.
Support final system handover to operations.

Performance Testing
Lead mechanical and piping aspects of plant performance testing.
Verify systems and equipment meet defined performance and operational criteria.
Support optimisation and corrective activities identified during start-up and performance testing.

HSSE & Compliance
Ensure commissioning activities comply with project HSSE requirements, industry standards and applicable regulations.
Promote safe working practices and a strong safety culture throughout mechanical and piping commissioning.
Ensure appropriate controls are applied to pressure testing, leak testing and other high-risk commissioning activities.

Stakeholder & Team Coordination
Collaborate with the CSU Manager, engineering, construction, operations, vendors, contractors and other commissioning disciplines.
Coordinate commissioning interfaces and ensure activities align with overall project objectives and schedules.
Provide leadership, technical guidance and mentoring to commissioning personnel.
Identify opportunities to improve commissioning methods, system readiness and execution efficiency.

Technical Skills
Extensive knowledge of static and rotating mechanical equipment and piping systems.
Strong expertise in nitrogen-helium leak testing, flange management and piping integrity testing.
Knowledge of mechanical completion, pre-commissioning, commissioning, start-up and performance testing.
Strong understanding of relevant ASME, ANSI and API standards.
Experience with piping and commissioning systems/software; SmartPlant or Hexagon experience is advantageous.
Strong planning, scheduling, resource management and project coordination capability.
API 570, ASME B31.3 or other relevant mechanical/piping certification is advantageous.
Strong troubleshooting and technical problem-solving skills.

Qualifications & Experience
Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
Minimum 10 years' experience commissioning mechanical equipment and piping systems within major industrial projects.
Demonstrable experience with static and rotating equipment, piping systems, mechanical completion and commissioning.
Proven expertise in leak testing, flange management, piping testing, pre-commissioning, start-up and plant performance testing.
Strong knowledge of industry standards and regulatory requirements applicable to mechanical and piping systems.
Ability to lead commissioning activities within complex, fast-paced project environments.
Strong communication, leadership and stakeholder-management skills.
Proficiency with relevant commissioning systems and software.
Green hydrogen and/or green steel experience is advantageous.
Project management experience or qualifications are advantageous.
Fluent English required; Swedish language skills are advantageous but not essential.

jobs.occupation: Account Executive for Ecoroute
jobs.description:
Are you driven, business‑oriented, and eager to grow within B2B sales? We are now looking for an Account Executive who will have the opportunity to be part of scaling a new, AI‑driven product within a European software group. You’ll take on a central role in a successful and ambitious team, with strong opportunities to develop and make a real impact. Sounds interesting? Keep on reading!
Movement Software is a Northern European software group focused on niched industry verticals. In our Transport, Logistics & Geodata vertical, Ecoroute/Tetrasoft, Geposit, Postnummerservice, and Dimaps form a strong ecosystem of specialized software companies. Through close collaboration, they deliver complementary solutions that help businesses improve efficiency, gain better control, and navigate an increasingly complex world.
In our companies, we develop data‑driven software solutions that solve real operational challenges for our customers. Our value-adding offering includes address & geodata solutions, geographical management tools, last‑meter delivery planning & production systems and route optimization & delivery execution platforms. Our customers are mainly within transportation, logistics, and field services – but we also help companies in other industries as well.
With our newly developed next-generation platform, Ecoroute, we are redefining how companies plan, optimize and execute their daily transportation operations. From route optimization to real-time execution, we help our customers reduce costs, improve service levels, and make better decisions every day.
About the role As an Account Executive you will play a key role in driving the growth across Sweden and other Nordic and Northern European countries. You will own the full sales cycle from first contact to signed deal, working closely with decision-makers in transport, logistics, and field service industries. You will collaborate with product and customer teams to ensure a strong fit and high-quality customer experience.
You will be part of an ambitious, high-performance environment where we push each other to improve and win together. The position is based in Malmö, Sweden, located at one of our sister companies to ensure close collaboration to Geopt’s Chief Commercial Officer, who is based in Denmark.
Your responsibilities:

Prospect, qualify, and build a strong pipeline of potential customers.

Lead customer meetings, both digital and in person, an demonstrate the value of our offerings – with particular focus on Ecoroute.

Drive negotiations and close new deals.

Work closely with your colleagues within the Customer Success and Product teams to ensure successful onboarding and long-term value for the customer.

Provide market feedback and insights that shape product and commercial development.

Who we are looking for We are looking for someone who is proactive, ambitious, and results-driven – with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to move deals forward. You will thrive in this role if you have experience with B2B sales, preferably within SaaS. We also believe that you have:

A strong set of communication skills and the ability to build trust quickly.

A comprehensive and solution‑oriented mindset.

Natural authority and execution power, combined with a positive and pragmatic attitude.

Hunter mentality.

"Grit" – you don't give up, even when the work presents challenges.

The ability to communicate fluently in both Swedish and English.

A valid driver’s license.

Experience from the transportation or logistics industry is considered a plus, as well as the ability to “speak tech,” such as understanding APIs, integrations, and technical concepts.
Interested? Contact us! Does this sound like a role and environment that would suit you? Apply, connect with us, or share this opportunity with someone you think might be a great fit.
If you have questions, reach out to Linnea Olsson, People Business Partner at Movement Software.
We are a part of Movement Software
Ecoroute is part of Movement Software (formerly Progrits), a Northern European software group consisting of around twenty entrepreneur-led companies across three business areas: Vehicle digital solutions, Transport & logistics, and the public mobility. Since 2023, Movement Software has been part of Axcel, a Nordic private equity firm with a strong focus on the technology sector.
Being part of Movement Software provides us with greater opportunities for growth and development, both as a company and as individuals, while also offering the stability and resources of a larger group.
